row_title: Publish a note as a link: the operator approval ceremony end to end

steps.caption: The dashboard's sign-in gate: automation arrives signed out, exactly like a person
Password unlock (the zero-passkey fallback path) opens the dashboard; a first-run passkey offer, when shown, is declined
actions: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Not now'); if (b) { b.click(); } return true; })()

steps.caption: An agent asked to publish a note as a share link; the approval sheet presents the trusted note title, the org identity, and the link duration
The operator authorizes with the organization password; signing happens in the browser and the key never exists server-side
Approve & publish: the browser signs the request, the serving tunnel starts, and the link is minted
